No first-hand official fixture capture this session (NRL off-season window; no international match confirmed from an official page in this session). Flagged (PU-12).
AFL men's season is complete (Grand Final was September); no official fixture was confirmed first-hand for this window. Flagged (PU-13).

The schedule page prints no ranking for unseeded players; seed 33 is a model placeholder for 'unseeded man in a 32-player draw', documented in METHODOLOGY-style notes on the site methodology page. It is not a claim about any official ranking.

Home-edge multipliers (NHL 1.045, EHF 1.03), NHL OT home share 0.55, seed exponents (darts 1.15, tennis 0.55) and Pro D2 constants (3.5 home points, 1.35 pts/place, sd 13) are documented model assumptions, not official data; sensitivity is shown on the methodology page.
European Championship seeds are the PDC's one-year European Tour ranking seeds, not the PDC Order of Merit; leg model uses seeds only.
OLBG lists the event as 'USA Grand Prix'; the official FIA title is 'United States Grand Prix' (Round 18, COTA, 23-25 Oct). Reconciled as the same event.
World Series run-line and total were not originated: no verified probable-pitcher or bullpen workload data was captured from official MLB pages in this session. Money lines only.
Match-total markets for Pro D2 were not originated: the official J8 page lists table positions but no verified points-scored data in the captured region.
All OLBG-listed eligible-sport events at capture were reconciled against official fixtures; see OLBG crosscheck in inputs.json. No excluded-sport row is originated anywhere on /pulse/.
